pre_observation_correction.reason: Implementation preflight found that the first standard-decode powers-of-two grid exceeded the 2^12 factor in 1000000000000 ps.
pre_observation_correction.changed: Only the standard-decode and MTP request rates were replaced with exact decimal divisors.

allocation_ruling.source_interpretation: The four-node prefill and nine-node decode tables are separate benchmark experiments on the disclosed 12-node cluster.
allocation_ruling.joint_deployments: Second-legend what-if context only, never a disclosure reproduction anchor.

largest_faithful_live_scale.reason: The landed session has physical curve evidence only for isolated stock schedulers under one serialized parent clock. Adding engine processes changes parent scheduling rather than demonstrating parallel node service.
largest_faithful_live_scale.placement_authority: The full EP32 and EP72 role subsets and the joint 16-prefill plus 40-decode context use disaggregated_target_topology_v1. The live one-plus-one scheduler scale is never relabeled as a full live engine deployment.

expected_curve_shapes.expectation: Throughput rises with offered load toward a prompt-length-dependent plateau; inverse per-token delay falls after queueing becomes material; longer prompts order the plateau 1K above 2K above 4K.
Throughput rises toward the priced standard-decode capacity while inverse per-token delay decreases as queueing accumulates.
The curve is decode-limited at saturation and appears only in the second legend as declared PLACE-5 context.

offered_load_sweep_requests_per_second.rule: Every load divides 1000000000000 ps exactly. The MTP grid is frozen but not executed until its exact price exists.

tunable.application_arithmetic: 2 routed collectives per MoE layer times 58 MoE layers

provenance.physical_basis: Zero is the modeled propagation floor; 30128029 ps is the measured width-8 pessimistic selectable surcharge.
The analytical host-store floor is 100000 ps and the accepted request-level packet arm declares 20000000 ps.

fixed_but_propagated.reason_not_tuned: No calibration-split anchor provides an exact handoff latency observable.

provenance.physical_basis: PLACE-5 fixes 400 Gbit/s physical links; the 200 Gbit/s endpoint is the frozen sensitivity arm.

fixed_but_propagated.reason_not_tuned: The public cluster disclosure names InfiniBand but provides no exact transfer-latency calibration anchor.

derived_and_propagated.formula: last_required_arrival_ps - first_packet_start_ps from the packet arm
derived_and_propagated.lower_rule: PLACE-5 link arithmetic at 400 Gbit/s plus fixed propagation
derived_and_propagated.upper_rule: the same exact packet bytes and endpoints at 200 Gbit/s
derived_and_propagated.reason_not_tuned: Packet service is a backend result, not an adjustable fit constant.

pre_tuning_prediction_model.band_rule: Lower throughput uses the upper collective envelope; upper throughput uses the lower collective envelope.
pre_tuning_prediction_model.candidate_scope: Noncollective full-depth per-rank service from the pinned candidate. The predicted band is deterministic and is not a confidence interval.

pre_tuning_predicted_bands.reason: The candidate record has no EP72 MTP batch-16 KV-4000 cell.

fit_rule.objective: Minimize the sum of squared relative point errors across calibration anchors inside every closed physical envelope.
fit_rule.out_of_envelope_rule: select the in-envelope minimizer and report the calibration miss; never widen or clip an envelope after observing held-out data

scoring_rule.decision: PASS only when the maximum point error over all scorable held-out anchors is at most 0.05. Propagated intervals are reported but cannot convert a point-error miss into a pass.
scoring_rule.one_shot: Held-out values are read once after the fit artifact is serialized and content-addressed.
scoring_rule.mtp_rule: Do not read the MTP numeric anchor in the pricing or scoring path. Emit a BLOCKED row naming COMP-72 and no prediction.
scoring_rule.overall_scope: The numerical verdict covers the two priced prefill held-out anchors only and always names the MTP gap.

uncertainty_rule.record_interval: Use the candidate record's exact point. The single retained DeepSeek seed supplies zero statistical half-width and is labeled insufficient-replays, not stable.
uncertainty_rule.distribution_interval: Propagate the record's zero CV contribution explicitly; do not invent repeat evidence.
uncertainty_rule.constant_interval: Evaluate both endpoints of every declared constant envelope.
uncertainty_rule.packet_interval: Evaluate the same bytes and endpoints at the fixed 400 Gbit/s point and 200 Gbit/s sensitivity edge.
uncertainty_rule.inverse_delay: Invert only after the complete positive delay interval, reversing its endpoints.

included: compute_pricing record_sha256, acceptance_status, pool and selected entry key hashes
stable_cross_run_identity_fields.reason: Frontend-owned pool-local request suffixes and operating-system process IDs are fresh per run and are not client-visible, pricing-relevant or timing-relevant identities.

figure_contract.y: inverse per-token request delay, increasing upward
figure_contract.main_legend: simulated SGLang configurations with deterministic bands
figure_contract.prefill_panel: Published and simulated 1K, 2K and 4K per-node prefill anchors, because input throughput has no honest coordinate on the main output-throughput axis.
figure_contract.verdict_annotation: Maximum scorable held-out point error plus an explicit MTP BLOCKED on COMP-72.

fatal_guards: dependency merge is absent from run head
frozen input digest or candidate status disagrees
prefill and decode disclosure experiments are rendered as one 96-GPU allocation
a scale reduction is missing its exact conserved multiplier
a fit path reads any held-out or context-only anchor
a stable identity guard compares complete serialized request results
the MTP anchor receives a non-MTP or imputed price
held-out scoring occurs before the fit artifact is frozen
a fitted value leaves its physical envelope
the figure carries a dry-run watermark or omits the verdict scope

expected_disposition.if_scorable_max_error_at_most_5_percent: Publish a scoped PASS for the two priced held-out prefill anchors and keep the MTP anchor BLOCKED on COMP-72.
expected_disposition.if_scorable_max_error_above_5_percent: Publish REFUTED with every per-anchor row, the dominant mechanistic contributor and a registered residual.
expected_disposition.core54_closure: Only if the literal registered acceptance text is satisfied; a blocked or refuted required anchor keeps CORE-54 open.
